in_sanskrit.name: विष्णु
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The deity who preserves and sustains the universe and all living beings. He is one of the primary deities in Hinduism and is often depicted as having four arms, holding a conch shell, a discus, a mace, and a lotus flower.

in_hindi.name: विष्ठुभाई
in_hindi.long_meaning: The elder brother who protects and sustains.

in_tamil.name: விஷ்ணுபால்
in_tamil.long_meaning: The elder brother who is Vishnu, the preserver and sustainer of the universe.

in_telugu.name: శీశ్యేశ్వరేభాయ
in_telugu.long_meaning: The elder brother who is Shishya (student) of Shiva (God of destruction) and is also known as Dashaya (ten-armed) and Ishwara (God).

in_marathi.name: Vishnubhai
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God in the form of Vishnu
in_marathi.long_meaning: Vishnubhai हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Vishnubhai is a name that translates to 'God in the form of Vishnu' in Hinduism. This name is derived from the Sanskrit language and is widely used in Hindu culture. Vishnu is one of the primary deities in Hinduism, known for his role as the preserver of the universe. The name Vishnubhai signifies loyalty, protection, power, and wisdom.
